title: Injectivity of the polar frequency map
statement: Let $n$ be even, and let $z\in\mathbb F_2^n$. If, for each coordinate $i$, the sum in $\mathbb F_2$ of all coordinates $z_j$ with $j\ne i$ is zero, then $z=0$.
hypotheses_covered: the polar frequency of $z$ is the zero vector
